paragraphs: From Clifden test centre set off along Galway Road for a short distance.
Take the 1st right onto the N59.
Continue for about 250 metres and take the next left to stay on the N59.
After roughly 270 metres turn right onto Westport Road.
Follow Westport Road as your settling-in stretch.
Turn right onto Hospital Road and follow it for around 600 metres.
Carry straight on as Hospital Road becomes Galway Road.
At the end of Galway Road turn right and continue for a short stretch.
Take the next left onto Main Street.
At the end of the road turn left onto Bridge Street.
Take the 1st right onto Market Street.
Take the sharp right into Market Square which becomes Main Street.
Bear slight right onto Bridge Street.
Bear slight right again onto Railway View.
Continue straight as it becomes Market Hill.
From Market Hill turn right onto Main Street.
Take a slight right onto Bridge Street.
Take a slight left onto Hulk Street.
Turn left onto The Low Road and follow it for about 340 metres.
Take the next left onto Galway Road for a short quieter section.
Turn right onto the N59.
Take the next left onto Church Hill.
Bear slight right as Church Hill becomes Sky Road.
Finish with calm mirror checks and a tidy controlled stop back at Clifden test centre.
